engineering_gates.interpretation: Finite prespecified simulation engineering criteria; not a universal 5% error-control guarantee.

dgp.marker_noise: standard normal independent of Z; partial-null noise mutually independent
dgp.z_dependent_censoring: exponential rate 0.04*exp(0.8*Z), independent conditional on Z
dgp.nonph: clinical beta +0.8 through time 10, -0.8 after time 10
dgp.partial_null: first five independent marker residuals causal with beta 0.2 or 0.4; remaining markers independent of causal residuals conditional on Z

diagnostics.clinical_family: global and per-term classic GT log-time PH plus linear-versus-fixed-five-knot-RCS LR; Holm over all applicable tests
diagnostics.residual_family: HC3 Wald nonlinear mean and variance across all retained markers; Holm over the entire family
diagnostics.mean_directions: standardized raw numeric Z^2 and Z^3 orthogonal to clinical basis and stratum intercepts
diagnostics.variance_directions: all clinical basis columns conditional on stratum intercepts; squared OLS residual divided by (1-leverage) removes the fitted projection variance effect
diagnostics.required_failure: withhold; do not shrink the prespecified family or replace a replicate

protocol.failure_policy: Retain every planned index and calculation failure. Report FWER lower and worst-case upper failure bounds with Clopper-Pearson MC intervals. No replacement or completion-only denominator.
protocol.confirmation_policy: Freeze source hashes, protocol and independent-reference results before main/extension execution. No method/threshold/condition changes after inspection of confirmation outcomes. Any later repair requires a new version and new seeds; preserve this study.
protocol.revision_scope: Proven separation diagnostic defect only: remove unconditional coefficient-per-SD magnitude flag. Numeric fits, PH and HC3 chi-square diagnostics, Holm families, 1% withholding threshold, scenarios, supported sets and engineering gates stay as in v1. Offline F sensitivity is excluded.
protocol.development_evidence: diagnostic-followup/development/1: 6000 new-seed datasets; descriptive, not qualification. V1 confirmation is retained as failed development evidence.
